defects.observable_failure: Create can publish an empty stable id after successful mutation.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Per-resource id patches leave shared publication wrong.

defects.observable_failure: Mutable directory mode can alter resource identity.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Special-casing mode leaves other mutable fields plan-derived.

defects.observable_failure: Changing a symlink target can churn Terraform identity.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Symlink-only suppression hides shared identity defects.

defects.observable_failure: Copy destination digest can disappear after provider restart.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Caching the digest in process memory is not durable state.

defects.observable_failure: External deletion of a directory is not reflected as absence on refresh.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Directory-only checks leave other resource Reads inconsistent.

defects.observable_failure: External mode drift can be replaced by stale prior state.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Normalization without native observation still misses drift.

defects.observable_failure: Out-of-band symlink retargeting is not reported as drift.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Existence checks without readlink semantics accept wrong state.

defects.observable_failure: External supplementary-group changes are not reflected in user state.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Passwd-only observation leaves group membership stale.

defects.observable_failure: Update can publish planned values before Ansible succeeds.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Moving one State.Set leaves other update paths unsafe.

defects.observable_failure: Failed update can leave state claiming the new desired configuration.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Returning an error after advancement still corrupts retry state.

defects.observable_failure: Changing source_digest can fail to trigger exactly one copy update.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Digest-specific logic does not repair shared transaction ordering.

defects.observable_failure: Updating a managed line can append instead of replace once.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Content matching alone does not restore stable ownership semantics.

defects.observable_failure: Failed delete can remove the resource from Terraform state.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Resource-specific retention leaves shared destroy semantics broken.

defects.observable_failure: Destroying a symlink can remove or mutate its target object.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Path deletion without lstat semantics is unsafe.

defects.observable_failure: Deleting one named block can remove unrelated sibling text.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Marker matching without ownership scope remains destructive.

defects.observable_failure: Deleting one named cron entry can disturb sibling entries.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Whole-crontab replacement violates scoped ownership.

defects.observable_failure: Shell metacharacters in paths can be interpreted instead of passed literally.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Escaping strings still leaves shell-text execution unsafe.

defects.observable_failure: Ansible timeout can leave a temporary playbook behind.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Success-path cleanup does not cover timeout terminals.

defects.observable_failure: Cancellation can publish success-like state before process termination is confirmed.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Context cancellation without transactional ordering remains unsafe.

defects.observable_failure: Full command output can leak into durable Terraform state.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Truncation still persists prohibited process output.

defects.observable_failure: Equivalent file modes can produce perpetual diffs.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Formatting only desired state leaves observed state noncanonical.

defects.observable_failure: Equivalent unordered variable maps can produce nondeterministic plans.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Sorting one resource leaves shared map serialization unstable.

defects.observable_failure: Equivalent supplementary group orderings can cause repeated updates.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Plan sorting without observed-state normalization still churns.

defects.observable_failure: Omitted cron defaults and explicit wildcard defaults can fail to converge.
defects.partial_fix_trap: Defaulting only Create leaves Read and Update representations divergent.

outputs.organic_f2p_surface_assessment: The defects arise from six coupled provider lifecycle concerns spanning shared state, native observation, mutation transactions, scoped deletion, process control and normalization; they are reachable through normal Terraform operations across the ten resources rather than synthetic padding.

root_cause_clusters.RC5_RUNNER_COMMAND: process invocation timeout cancellation and cleanup defects
